body: Audit (6 Nov 2026): the authorization of the real server was run, not read: `python -X utf8 docs/evidence/scripts/audit_stack.py check authz` makes a member through an invitation and tries the owner's playlists and every owner-only route: 15 of 15 PASS (404 for another person's playlist, 403 for owner-only routes, a member cannot promote themself).
